tasks.brief:
Root planner already discovered the repo. Write exactly one file: docs/s10-brief.md.

Current state (do not treat as work to redo):
- GET /api/leads in apps/api/src/router.ts calls listLeadRows(ctx.db) with no query params.
- listLeadRows lives in packages/harness/src/scheduler.ts and already attaches oppStage.
- apps/web ListPage (apps/web/src/App.tsx) already has client-only tabs 全部/未转化/已转化/待确认 plus text search; getLeads(role) fetches the full list once.
- No CSV import endpoint or UI exists.
- Hard context is docs/contracts/S9.md plus M0–M6. Engineering rule: tests must pass; no emoji; 橙果素质教育 stays 未转化; eight company names unchanged.

Lock these semantics in docs/s10-brief.md:

## Filter
GET /api/leads?status=&stage=
- status in LEAD_STATUSES: 新线索, 已转化. Omit = no status filter.
- stage in OPP_STAGES: 需求确认, 方案报价, 谈判, 赢单, 丢单. Omit = no stage filter. Stage matches opportunities.stage via oppStage. Unconverted leads have oppStage null so they never match a stage filter.
- Combine with AND. status=新线索&stage=方案报价 returns [].
- Unknown status or stage -> 400 { ok:false, error } (Chinese error ok).
- Response shape unchanged: { leads: LeadRow[] } including oppStage.
- No params: same as today (all leads).
Implement listLeadRows(db, { status?, stage? }) in packages/harness and keep HTTP thin. Export from packages/harness/src/index.ts if needed.
Seed lock: status=新线索 includes 橙果素质教育; stage=方案报价 includes 杭齿精密机电 and 邻里鲜超市; stage=丢单 includes 江东水务物资.

## CSV import
POST /api/leads/import
- Body JSON { csv: string } (UTF-8, optional BOM). Do not add a CSV npm dependency.
- Required header: company,industry,contactName,sourceSummary. Optional column searchTags.
- Each valid row inserts a lead: status=新线索, ownerUserId null, lastActivity 'CSV 导入', no account/contact/opportunity/activity, do NOT call ingestLead or any Agent runner.
- Duplicate company (exact string match against existing leads.company, including the eight seeds) -> skip with reason, do not error the whole request.
- Empty/missing company -> that row in errors; continue others.
- viewer -> 403, db unchanged. sales and manager allowed.
- After any successful insert, call rebuildLeadVec(sqlite) so S9 similar search stays consistent.
- Response: { ok, imported: [{ id, company }], skipped: [{ company, reason }], errors: [{ line, message }] }.
- New ids like lead-csv-<n> or lead-csv-<slug>-<n>; do not reuse seed ids.
- CORS stays GET,POST,OPTIONS.

## Web
- Keep existing tabs. Add stage chips for the five 商机阶段 (reuse .filter buttons). Selecting 未转化 should request status=新线索; selecting a stage should request stage=...; 全部 with no stage omits params. 待确认 may remain client-side on pendingIds.
- Add CSV import on the list toolbar: file input, sales/manager only; viewer hides control or shows 403. Call POST /api/leads/import then refresh the list.
- Extend apps/web/src/api.ts getLeads(role, query?) and add importLeadsCsv(role, csv). Keep x-hengce-role. No CURSOR_API_KEY / @cursor/sdk in apps/web.
- Do not change the funnel rail, HITL gates, or apps/web-demo (still no fetch).

## Tests and docs (later tasks, but specify here)
- apps/api/src/router.test.ts: filter cases + import cases + viewer 403.
- packages/harness tests for listLeadRows filters and import helper.
- apps/web/src/r6.test.ts: assert list UI copy for stage chips and CSV import, and /api/leads/import in api.ts.
- Final docs: docs/checklists/S10.md and docs/contracts/S10.md; update docs/skill-timeline.md S10 to done; point previous contracts' 下一刀 away from 'S10 未做'.

Forbidden: Redis, MQ, GraphRAG, web-demo fetch, funnel/order/gate changes, English Discovery/Demo stages, emoji, putting .orchestrate plan.json into CRM runtime, using /orchestrate to schedule lead-intake.
